evals.prompt: I just finished a master's in computer science and want to work as a product manager in AI. Build me a knowledge base about the AI agents industry like a proper research vault, in English, private GitHub repo under my account. Start with phase 1 and stop after it.
evals.expected_output: Intake summary confirmed or defaults stated; atlas.config.yaml with 8-14 AI-agent segments; scaffolded repo; localized Conventions.md and Industry-Taxonomy.md with axes, segment tree (Mermaid), summary table, value chain, PM lens and edge cases; folder READMEs rewritten; validator passes; phase-1 commit; stops after Phase 1 with a checkpoint message.

evals.prompt: Хочу понять игровую индустрию перед поиском работы. Сделай базу знаний на русском, регионы US, EU, Asia. Сейчас нужна только фаза 2B: 40 компаний для теста, сегменты уже есть в конфиге.
evals.expected_output: Company YAML data written outside the repo in batches, gen_company_cards.py run with Russian labels from the config, 40 cards plus master README grouped by region, dated metrics with confidence levels and ⚠️ markers, search-based social links, validator (with --mixed-script) passes, commit for phase 2B.

evals.prompt: It's Monday. Make the weekly report for my cybersecurity atlas in ~/code/cyber-atlas and update whatever cards need updating.
evals.expected_output: Chooses the ISO week that just ended and says so; creates the draft with new_weekly_report.py; researches in parallel; excludes items whose publication date is outside the week; recomputes in-scope deal totals; updates affected company cards, trend signals and regulation files; adds the report to Reports/README.md; validator passes; commit 'monitor: weekly report YYYY-Www'; replies with headlines, updates and sources.
